minimal_future_reader_contract.scope: Read and validate bounded known-source facts only. This slice defines no bpl_policy producer, global_complete flag, native configure call or runtime service. A separate reviewed policy decision must account for required source coverage and fail closed if any is missing.
minimal_future_reader_contract.suggested_shape: One internal source-bound boot-context operation using caller-owned bounded workspace and one atomic output snapshot. Public inputs must not allow arbitrary registry path/key, raw kernel address or caller complete boolean. No implementation/API header is created here.
preconditions: Pinned kernel compiled-ABI verifier result tied to exact candidate KC bytes; exact BootArgs producer/wire profile/length and same-boot source identity supplied independently of the memory being interpreted. UUID/code hashes prove compiled layout only, not applied writer bytes.

Trusted boot-phase quiescence or serialization must prevent PE_state pointer replacement and OSData mutation/reallocation during copy. copyProperty retention prevents lifetime loss but does not make contained storage immutable; length rechecks/two passes cannot repair concurrent use-after-reallocation.

PE_state.initialized must be true and bootArgs nonnull, stable and known-accessible for the specific bounded common prefix. Use genuine offsetof/type facts for a bounded40-byte envelope copy, never memcpy(sizeof boot_args) or native tail access on a736-byte source.
Runtime16KiB page size and T8103/PA36 profile must be independently bound; no generic DRAM inference from pointer bit masks.
registry_copy: Use fixed /chosen in gIODTPlane, hold retained entry and every retained property through class/length/buffer validation and copy. Required absent properties, wrong class, null buffer, bad exact size or unsupported schema all refuse.

Known dram-base/dram-size require exactly8 little-endian bytes each. New host policy metadata needs a separately frozen key/schema with magic/version/exact bounded total length, no trailing bytes, unknown required flags/status refused. No such producer/property exists or is admitted by this probe.

Copy only bounded bytes to caller workspace while quiescence holds; keep borrowed getBytesNoCopy pointers internal and discard before releasing retained refs. Never publish the pointer or retained OSData as validated immutable policy.
minimum_host_property_content: Same-boot nonce/domain, board/SoC/profile and exact KC+ramdisk+source writer/HV identity; precise incoming/base ADT digest excluding the property itself, with final serialized ADT hash externally bound to avoid self-hash cycle. These are trusted-platform provenance, not authentication against a malicious producer.

Original guest RAM interval boundaries, common-prefix envelope, boot reservation extent through topOfKernelData and retained handoff allocation coverage; chosen DRAM is corroboration rather than a larger eligible envelope.

Declared exclusion source classes, exact cardinalities/record sizes/digests and per-source status. Preserve framebuffer, pmap-io24-byte records, physical-device segments and other required source intervals with explicit omissions/unknowns. An old count/sentinel or known disjoint range cannot imply complete coverage.

Historical80-byte compact list cannot reconstruct enable/disabled/bad-bound/plane/stability data. FOUR_PLANES_FOUR_TZ_ONLY must remain distinct from global exclusions.

binding_and_atomicity: Copy primitive input metadata before calls; reject workspace/output/input overlap and capacity failures before writes. Retained objects are temporary internal ownership only.

Stage all decoded facts, status/source-coverage and digest bindings in workspace. Require stable same boot, source identities and bounded original ranges before one output commit. Missing/malformed/changed inputs leave caller output bit-for-bit unchanged and return an explicit refusal/UNREADY reason.

Retire temporary retained registry/property refs on every path only under their ordinary ownership rules; no manager/native-backing acquisition or configuration occurs. No success stub for unavailable complete provenance.
